evidence.title: Pickup and return
evidence.content:
# Pickup and return

## Desks and opening hours

Velomarsh has three desks:

- Harbour Desk: 8:00 to 20:00 every day
- Central Station Desk: 8:00 to 20:00 every day
- Riverside Park Desk: 9:00 to 18:00 every day

## Returning to another desk

Bikes can be returned to any desk at no extra cost. One-way returns between desks are free.

evidence.title: Breakdown assistance
evidence.content:
# Breakdown assistance

## Roadside hotline

The roadside assistance hotline is open from 7:00 to 21:00 every day. Plus members are served first.

## Replacement bikes

Within 15 km of a desk, Velomarsh brings a replacement bike within 60 minutes. The replacement is free when the breakdown is caused by a mechanical fault. When the rider caused the damage, the damage policy applies.

evidence.title: Accessibility and adaptive bikes
evidence.content:
# Accessibility and adaptive bikes

## Adaptive bikes

Velomarsh offers hand cycles, adult tricycles, recumbent trikes and side-by-side tandems for riders with disabilities. Adaptive bikes should be reserved at least 72 hours in advance so a fitted bike is ready.

## Price

Adaptive bikes are charged at the city bike rate of $18 per day, whatever their type. A companion riding on a side-by-side tandem rides free.

evidence.title: Pickup and return
evidence.content:
# Pickup and return
## After-hours drop box

Central Station Desk has an after-hours drop box for bikes, open at all times. A drop-box return counts as returned at the time the bike is dropped, as recorded by the drop box camera. The bike is inspected the next morning, and the deposit release starts then.

evidence.title: Payment methods
evidence.content:
# Payment methods

## Accepted payment

Velomarsh accepts Visa, Mastercard and American Express credit cards and debit cards. Apple Pay and Google Pay can be used in the app. Desks do not accept cash.

## When customers are charged

The full rental price is charged at booking. Extension days are charged when the extension is approved. Late fees and damage charges are taken from the deposit or charged to the card on file.
